page.overview:
What is Sign?

A sign is a non-solid block that displays text and can be placed on the top or side of other blocks. A hanging sign is a decorative block that also displays text, and can be placed underneath blocks or with a solid self-supporting bracket. The text of both types of signs can be customized with dyes and glow ink sacs.

Signs can be broken with any tool or without a tool, but an axe is fastest.

A sign or a hanging sign also breaks and drops itself as an item if the block the sign is attached to is moved, removed or destroyed. However, a wall hanging sign will stay here if the block the hanging sign is attached to is removed.

If a sign is broken while being edited, the player continues to edit the sign, although breaking the sign stops the editing operation.
